Ford F150 Commercial Truck Decals

In Canada, almost every business has a car or a vehicle that they use to carry out their business duties. While there’s a vehicle with a lot of marketing real estate on it, why not use it to promote your business? A smart business person knows how to use every resource they have in order to make the business more recognizable. One way to make sure that everyone knows your business is to get vehicle decals.

When it comes to decals the possibilities are limitless. Our recent client owns a successful painting business called “Mer-Gon Painting”. The client uses a Ford F150 truck to go from one site to another and he saw the opportunity to make sure that everyone sees what his business is about and he took it. What could be better than mobile advertising that you only pay for once? He brought his Ford F150 truck to Vinyl Wrap Toronto’s garage and talked to our installers about his requirements.

As for his requirements, they were simple. He wanted something very simple and easy on the eyes. It’s a couple of decals that go on both sides as well as the back of the Ford F150 truck. The decals feature the company’s logo with the contact number. Plain and simple.

The reason why getting simple decals is considered effective is because they’re easy to read for others while you’re on the road driving.

For the truck decals, we use Avery Dennison’s Printable vinyl and laminate. The installation process was very easy for our expert installers since they have years of experience wrapping vehicles.

We’ve attached pictures of the Ford F150 truck with the decals on this page for you to see what the truck decals look like.

Here are some quick tips when you’re thinking of getting truck decals:

  • Keep it simple.
  • Use easy-to-read fonts.
  • Make decals large enough to be clearly seen.
  • Include contact information.
  • Include a unique element that pulls the focus.

If you have a vehicle that you could use to advertise your business or would like to enquire about truck decal cost, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to speak to one of our experts.
